description: How to pay BokenJapan for a sponsorship tier or a Verified listing check. Returns the live Stripe Payment Link (hosted checkout the human buyer opens and pays on), price in JPY incl. and excl. 10% consumption tax, refund policy and legal disclosure links, and the bank-transfer invoice route. Does not take card data and does not charge anything: the buyer completes payment on Stripe. Call without product_id to list products. Product data comes from https://bokenjapan.com/pay.json.

product_id.description: founding | featured | regional | prefecture | addon | verified_check (ids from pay.json). Omit to list all products.

quantity.description: Verified check: number of listings (one payment per listing). Sponsorship tiers: 1.

name: buy
title: Buy (get checkout link)
